metadata.question: Does Houston show higher nighttime light intensity in December 2012 and 2013 compared to the average light output during other months from 2012 to 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Houston, Texas (approximately -95.3698°, 29.7604°) - Collection: VIIRS daily NTL data (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 or NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2) - Date: 2012-2014 range. BUT VIIRS data starts from 2012-01-19 for VNP46A1. - Need to compare: December 2012 & December 2013 vs. average of other months (2012-2014) 2. Masking strategy: - VIIRS NTL data has quality flags. Should use QF_Cloud_Mask band to filter clouds. - Focus on clear pixels with good quality. 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NTL for December 2012 - Calculate mean NTL for December 2013 - Calculate mean NTL for all other months (Jan-Nov 2012, Jan-Nov 2013, Jan-Nov 2014, Dec 2014) - Compare: if BOTH Dec 2012 AND Dec 2013 > other_months_avg, answer A - Need to check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid values) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000) # 20km buffer # 2. data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
houston = ee.Geometry.Point([-95.3698, 29.7604]).buffer(20000)  # 20km buffer

# 2. Data Acquisition
collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \
    .filterBounds(houston) \
    .filterDate('2012-01-01', '2015-01-01') \
    .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m')

# Check if collection has data
total_size = collection.size().getInfo()
if total_size == 0:
    print("No VIIRS data available for Houston 2012-2014.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print(f"Total images found: {total_size}")
    
    # 3. Define time periods
    dec_2012 = collection.filterDate('2012-12-01', '2013-01-01')
    dec_2013 = collection.filterDate('2013-12-01', '2014-01-01')
    
    # Other months: everything except December 2012 and 2013
    other_months = collection.filter(
        ee.Filter.Or(
            ee.Filter.date('2012-01-01', '2012-12-01'),
            ee.Filter.date('2013-01-01', '2013-12-01'),
            ee.Filter.date('2014-01-01', '2015-01-01')
        )
    )
    
    dec_2012_size = dec_2012.size().getInfo()
    dec_2013_size = dec_2013.size().getInfo()
    other_size = other_months.size().getInfo()
    
    print(f"Dec 2012 images: {dec_2012_size}")
    print(f"Dec 2013 images: {dec_2013_size}")
    print(f"Other months images: {other_size}")
    
    if dec_2012_size == 0 or dec_2013_size == 0 or other_size == 0:
        print("Missing data for one or more periods.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # 4. Calculate means
        dec_2012_mean = dec_2012.mean()
        dec_2013_mean = dec_2013.mean()
        other_mean = other_months.mean()
        
        # Reduce to get statistics
        stats_dec_2012 = dec_2012_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=houston,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()
        
        stats_dec_2013 = dec_2013_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=houston,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()
        
        stats_other = other_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=houston,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()
        
        # Check pixel counts
        count_dec_2012 = dec_2012_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=houston,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Dec 2012 mean NTL: {stats_dec_2012}, pixels: {count_dec_2012}")
        print(f"Dec 2013 mean NTL: {stats_dec_2013}")
        print(f"Other months mean NTL: {stats_other}")
        
        # 5. Validation & Final Answer
        if stats_dec_2012 is None or stats_dec_2013 is None or stats_other is None:
            print("Calculation returned None.")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif count_dec_2012 == 0:
            print("No valid pixels after processing.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        elif stats_dec_2012 > stats_other and stats_dec_2013 > stats_other:
            print("Both December 2012 and 2013 show higher NTL than other months.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("December months do not show consistently higher NTL.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
